A synthesizer is an electronic instrument that makes sound by generating an audio signal, Hornbostel–Sachs number 53. It usually produces waveforms by subtractive, additive and frequency modulation synthesis, then uses filters to add or remove frequencies, envelopes to shape how a note begins and ends, and low-frequency oscillators to modulate pitch, volume or filter character. Players mostly play it from a keyboard, but it can also be controlled by a sequencer, software or another instrument, and through MIDI (the standard for synchronising electronic instruments) it works together with other equipment. The synthesizer originated in the United States and is used by musicians, electronic ensembles and pop and rock groups in live performance and music production, in almost every kind of music.

Its range is wide, running from deep bass to bright, piercing highs. What sets it apart is a rich overtone structure and flexible modulation, so that the sound is mechanical and organic at once. Compared with the natural resonance of a piano, the Buchla offers an artificially shaped acoustic space; compared with the weight of a pipe organ, its timbre is more experimental and more futuristic. That has made it an ideal choice for electronic music, modern classical music and sound art.

歐系模組合成器是一種模組化電子樂器，由獨立的功能模組（如振盪器、濾波器、包絡線等: The Eurorack modular is a modular electronic instrument made of independent function modules — oscillators, filters, envelopes and so on — combined freely with patch cables. From the late 1990s through the 2000s the granular synth became an important tool for electronic music producers and experimental musicians, widely used in avant-garde music, electronic dance music and film scoring. Today the technique is a standard feature of modern music production software and continues to shape contemporary sound design.
顆粒合成器透過將音頻分解成微小的聲音顆粒進行重組，產生獨特而富有層次的音色。其音: By breaking audio into tiny grains of sound and reassembling them, a granular synth produces a distinctive, richly layered timbre. Its sound is mechanical and organic at once, and its quality ranges enormously from bright and transparent to dark and hazy. In the upper register it has a crystalline graininess; in the middle and low register it sounds heavy and resonant. Compared with the linear sound of a traditional synthesizer, its timbre is more fluid and more textured, like the vibration of microscopic particles. Sound is produced by precise keyboard control, the dynamic behaviour of electronic circuits and the physical resonance of the mechanical structure together, so the timbre keeps a digital coldness and also an analogue warmth. This quality, between analogue and digital, has made it widely used in experimental music and contemporary composition.
鼓機主要由塑膠或金屬外殼構成，內部搭載電路板與數位晶片。音頻輸出部分採用揚聲器或: A drum machine is built mainly from a plastic or metal case holding circuit boards and digital chips. The audio output is a loudspeaker or a built-in amplifier. Analogue drum machines use electronic parts such as capacitors and resistors to make their sounds; digital ones store samples in memory. The keys are rubber or plastic. Some models have knobs and faders for adjusting parameters. Power comes from batteries or an AC adapter.
鼓機是一種電子樂器，用於製造打擊樂聲音、鼓聲節奏和模式。鼓機可以模仿鼓組或其他打: A drum machine is an electronic instrument for making percussion sounds, drum rhythms and patterns. It can imitate a drum kit or other percussion instruments, or produce distinctive sounds such as synthesised electronic tones. Drum machines usually come with preset rhythms and patterns for popular genres and styles such as pop, rock and dance music. Most modern drum machines made in the 2010s and 2020s also let users program their own rhythms and drum sounds. A drum machine can make its sounds by analogue synthesis or play pre-recorded samples.
鼓機的音色具有鮮明的電子特質，音色明亮而乾淨，帶有輕微的機械感。其音域跨越低頻的: The timbre of a drum machine is distinctly electronic: bright and clean, with a slight mechanical feel. Its range runs from low, heavy drum sounds to crisp high cymbals, covering a broad span of frequencies. Sounds made by analogue synthesis are warm and full, while played samples give a lifelike drum kit. Its resonance is direct and lacks the natural resonance of a real drum kit, so the outline of the sound is sharper and clearer. Compared with a real drum kit, a drum machine is more regular and more precise, with a very strong sense of rhythm; compared with other electronic instruments, its percussion has more impact and drives the rhythm harder, which has made it an essential foundation of modern pop music.
